title: FDNVERB -- 8-line feedback delay network reverb (bpatcher module)

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: REVERB: Decay (0.1-30 s tail), PreDly (0-500 ms), Size (room size), Diffuse (early density).
Damp darkens the tail. Bloom: 0 = instant onset, higher = the reverb swells in.
MOD: Rate and Depth of the slow delay-time wobble that keeps the tail smooth.
EQ: Low and High shelves on the reverb, +/-12 dB.
OUT: Mix (dry/wet). Freeze holds the current tail forever until switched off.

sections.heading: AS A BPATCHER
lines: Inlets: audio L, audio R (summed to mono into the tank), param messages.
Param messages: decay / predelay / size / diffusion / damping / bloom / modrate / moddepth,
eq_low / eq_high / drywet <float>, freeze <0/1>. The dials follow them.
Outlets: audio L, audio R, already dry/wet mixed. For a mono source, feed both inlets.
See FDNVerb.maxhelp: test impulse, live input, output gain + meters and two example presets.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: gen~ FDNverb: pre-delay and allpass diffusion feed 8 modulated delay lines.
An 8x8 Hadamard matrix mixes the lines back into each other; per-line lowpass damps the tail.
Line gains are set from Decay so the tail length matches it; Freeze sets them to unity.
